title: Keylatch connection policy
description: Who may use one connection, and how. A connection with no entry for a caller kind is unusable by that kind: everything not allowed is denied. schema_version 2 is the base the policy v2 schema extends; unknown keys are rejected so that nothing a policy author writes is silently ignored.

connection.description: The connection this document governs. "*" is the fallback for connections without a document of their own.

default.description: What happens to a caller kind with no entry. Only deny exists.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the connection may be used for, as globs. Omitted means every capability a caller kind entry allows.

max_ttl.description: Longest lifetime of a session token or child process, as a Go duration such as 15m.

runtimes.description: Runtimes the caller may use. Omitted means any. A request with no runtime, such as call, is not covered by an entry that lists runtimes.

exe.description: Executables a run may start, matched against the command exactly as written: a bare name such as python3 does not cover /tmp/x/python3. Not checked for requests without a command, such as gateway calls.

units.description: systemd units a service caller must run in.
